data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant strengthening of prior year reserves by GBP 31.7 million in 2014, representing a 30.31% increase relative to opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by later claims development in the primary PI book, which saw its ultimate gross claims position move out by GBP 17.0 million. Additionally, the D&O account deteriorated by GBP 6.8 million, linked to a London market MGA. The overall claims deterioration was also attributed to loss information on closed years manifesting in Q3 and Q4 of 2014, and the lingering effects of the Global Credit Crunch and ensuing detrimental economic conditions on older years. Specific movements included a GBP 4.0 million release on the PI excess of loss account.
